## Teaching points

1. Bite cells, hemoglobinuria and indirect hyperbilirubinemia suggest oxidative hemolysis. Enzyme testing during reticulocytosis may need repeating after recovery.
2. Trend anemia and renal function, remove oxidant exposures and consider transfusion according to clinical status and ongoing hemolysis.
3. An enzyme assay can be falsely reassuring during an acute episode; arrange confirmation after recovery. The simulator does not provide G6PD assays or blood transfusion orders.
